# make commands

Every `make` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `make:command`

Scaffold a new CLI command with #[AsCommand]

```bash
bin/semitexa make:command
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--module` | yes |
| `--name` | yes |
| `--command-name` | yes |
| `--description` | yes |
| `--dry-run` | no |
| `--write` | no |
| `--force` | no |
| `--json` | no |
| `--llm-hints` | no |
